segments.title: Found at an AIRPORT. How OLD?
segments.say: A skeleton was found at Mexico City's new airport. How old is it? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 13,000 YEARS!

segments.say: About thirteen thousand years! Among the oldest found in the Valley of Mexico.

segments.title: Two dating methods
segments.say: Two dating methods put him at about twelve to thirteen thousand years.
